post.description:
Import Markdown as a new document, or as the next version of ``document``, after a preview; ``dry_run`` stops
at the preview.

Drop the items of the latest version that hold ``codes`` (codes or aliases), each with its subtree, as the
document's next version, a draft built on the latest through the same save as any other, so its checks hold and a
code dropped is never given again; as an admin of the project, never the agent of a run. 422 listing each code no
item of the latest version holds, one dropped before included; ``dry_run`` answers what would be dropped and writes
nothing.

Send a draft to review, once it has no error. Each time a version goes to review, in every round, @ba reviews it
when the project enabled the agent type ba: its comments block nothing, and an open finding of level decide it
records holds approval.

Approve a version in review or ask for changes. Nobody who wrote a version since the one approved last reviews
it, and the agent of a run never does. An approval answers 409 while the document has an open finding of level
decide, naming each, or while @ba's review of the version's round is queued or running. An approval emits the
event srs.version.approved; once the hub delivers it, in a project that enables the plugin tasks, each use case new
in the version gets a frame task, the open tasks of a use case that changed a comment and those of one it dropped
are cancelled, and @ba splits the frame tasks into child tasks.

Approve one use case of a version in review or ask for changes on it, under the conditions of a review of the
version; a later review of the same member on the use case replaces the earlier one when they are counted. 422 for
an item that is no use case the version needs reviewed (one it adds, changes or drops since the version approved
last) and for a request for changes with no note. An approval goes through the gate of a version's (409 while a
finding of level decide is open or @ba's review runs); a request for changes leaves the version in review and
blocks every approval of it. The version is approved by the review that makes every use case to review approved,
as its version-wide reviews do: it emits srs.version.approved as any approval. Answers the version with its use
cases.

get.description:
The merge requests of the project's queue (``repo``'s alone when given), newest first, each with its ledger, and
its audit samples.

For each repo, agent and model, the merges of the last ``days``: how many, reverted, rolled back, passed by
the Judge and found wrong, and the time in the queue and to the checks.

post.description: An admin of the project answers an audit sample: ``ok``, or ``faulty``, which counts against the Judge.

An admin approves the PROD release of a merge whose repo the policy releases by hand (``prod_release``
manual): the hub's next pass runs its deploy job, carrying the merges before it.

An admin asks the hub to revert a merge it followed after its merge, such as one of the suspects of a failed
check it could not tell apart: the hub's next pass opens its revert, first in the queue.

An admin of the project passes the hold of a merge request at a gate that holds it for a person (gate 3, score
hacking), with a reason: it is gated again at the same head, and the queue goes on from that gate; the later gates,
the Judges, its turn and its pipeline still apply, and a new push takes the pass back.

An admin of the project resets the breaker of a repo that tripped: its paused merge requests wait for their turn
again, at their place, and what trips it counts from now.

handback_requested_at.title: Handback Requested At
handback_requested_at.description: the owner asked to let the agent go on headless

waiting_since.title: Waiting Since
waiting_since.description: when the agent's turn ended with a decision open, while waiting

parked_at.title: Parked At
parked_at.description: when the run was parked, for want of an answer

request.title: Request
request.description: the member's request of an author run; null for any other kind

finish_requested_at.title: Finish Requested At
finish_requested_at.description: when the owner ended the chat of an author run its worker holds; null otherwise

steady_wait.description: a queued attempt after a run lost on a worker that is not steady yet: that worker takes it only once it is; another worker may take it now unless it is pinned to that one. Null otherwise

failure_cause.title: Failure Cause
failure_cause.description: why the run failed, as its worker reported it: origin, credentials or missing_tool when its preflight stopped it before the agent started, else push_conflict, verify_failed, timeout and the others of runs.FAILURE_CAUSES; null for a run that did not fail, one an older daemon or the hub ended, and every run from before schema 0024

session_per_step.title: Session Per Step
session_per_step.description: a plan run whose worker starts a new agent session for each step; its usage lists the sessions (usage.sessions). False for any other run

browser.title: Browser
browser.description: a run whose agent got a Chromium of its own on its worker (dispatched with browser); false for any other

browser_identities.title: Browser Identities
browser_identities.description: the ids of the browser identities the run's Chromium opened with, in the order dispatched

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: the handle of the agent profile the run went under; null for a run from before schema 0030

profile_id.title: Profile Id
profile_id.description: that profile's id, which its handle names for good

profile_version.title: Profile Version
profile_version.description: the version of the profile whose rules apply to the run

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: the environment of a plugin, <plugin>/<name>, its claim picked from the environment axis of its profile, a container its agent runs in; null for a run on the worker's host, and before a claim

chat_id.title: Chat Id
chat_id.description: a chat run's group chat; null for any other run

chat_message_id.title: Chat Message Id
chat_message_id.description: the message of the chat that started a chat run: the mention, or the reply that woke it

hop.title: Hop
hop.description: a chat run's hop: 1 for a person's mention, one more for each agent's mention after it (at most 3); null for any other run

session_run_id.title: Session Run Id
session_run_id.description: a chat run's session: the id of its first run, which its branch chat/<id> names (the run's own id for the first); null for any other run

session_turn.title: Session Turn
session_turn.description: a chat run's turn in its session: 1 for its first run, one more for each after it; null for any other run

session_turns.title: Session Turns
session_turns.description: the runs of a chat run's session so far; null for another run

session_title.title: Session Title
session_title.description: the title of a chat run's session, its first run's, which the pull requests of its branch take; each run after it is titled by the message that woke it. Null for any other run

machine.title: Machine
machine.description: a local run's machine, as its hub login names it; null otherwise

cwd.title: Cwd
cwd.description: the directory a local run's session works in; null otherwise

claude_email.title: Claude Email
claude_email.description: the Claude account that ran a local run's session, or unknown; null for any other run

claude_profile.title: Claude Profile
claude_profile.description: the claude-profiles profile of a local run, when it was read

last_activity_at.title: Last Activity At
last_activity_at.description: the last time a local run's session said anything; null for any other run

principal.title: Principal
principal.description: the login of the person the run acts for, whose autonomy bounds it (plan autonomy-levels); null for a local run and one queued before the hub knew principals

autonomy.description: the autonomy it acts under; null where principal is

as_owner.title: As Owner
as_owner.description: its owner lets its agent call the hub's API as them, secrets, tokens and workers aside, through a token of the run's own while a worker holds it (PUT .../runs/{id}/access changes it)

as_owner_since.title: As Owner Since
as_owner_since.description: when its owner let it run as them: at dispatch, or later through PUT .../access or the answer to a credential request; the run that resumes a parked run, and the next attempt of a lost one, keep the time of the run before it. Null while it does not run as its owner

account.title: Account
account.description: the account the run has now, by name

how.title: How
how.description: picked by hand, bound to the worker, by the charter, the pool, cooling, shared by another member

failovers.title: Failovers
failovers.description: the times the run moved to another account

events.title: Events
events.description: each usage limit the run hit with it, oldest first

action.title: Action
action.description: the run moved to another account, or it stopped

account.title: Account
account.description: the account that hit its usage limit, by name

to.title: To
to.description: with failover: the account the run went on with

cooldown_until.title: Cooldown Until
cooldown_until.description: until when the account cools down

level.title: Level
level.description: the lowest level of the sources, A0 to A5

level_source.title: Level Source
level_source.description: the source that sets that level

classes.title: Classes
classes.description: K1 to K12, each its mode

environments.title: Environments
environments.description: the environments it may run in; null: no limit

workers.title: Workers
workers.description: the workers (names, lowered) that may take it; null: any

restricted.title: Restricted
restricted.description: whether a class is below auto, so only a daemon that applies the modes takes it

also.title: Also
also.description: logins besides the principal whose autonomy bounds it

tightened_at.title: Tightened At
tightened_at.description: when a gate last made it stricter; null: never

RunAutonomy.title: RunAutonomy
RunAutonomy.description:
The autonomy a run acts under: its principal's effective autonomy as the hub took it when it queued the run,
made stricter by every gate that found it lower since (``run_autonomy.recheck``).

source.title: Source
source.description: the source that sets the mode, as GET /v1/autonomy names it

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: the condition the mode acts under; null for none

RunAutonomyClass.title: RunAutonomyClass
RunAutonomyClass.description: One class of a run's autonomy snapshot (plan autonomy-levels): its mode, the source that set it and how.

size.title: Size
size.description: bytes, at most the limit of the kind

max_usd.title: Max Usd
max_usd.description: the most it may cost; Claude Code stops there

max_turns.title: Max Turns
max_turns.description: the most turns its agent may take

max_seconds.title: Max Seconds
max_seconds.description: the agent time it may use; a Codex run stops there

RunBudget.title: RunBudget
RunBudget.description: The caps of a run the night shift queued (``evo_agents.hub.curator``).

card.title: Card
card.description: the card's text, first in the run's prompt

modes.title: Modes
modes.description: K1 to K12, the mode each acts in for the agent: an ask a project policy sets shows as auto

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: the categories of decision its agent may ask

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: K1 to K12, what set the mode of each: a ceiling, a preference, a policy

principal.title: Principal
principal.description: the login of the run's principal, which its commits name in the trailer Evo-Principal

RunCard.title: RunCard
RunCard.description:
The autonomy card of a run (plan autonomy-levels, ``autonomy_card.card``): what its prompt opens with, built
from the run's snapshot and its principal when the worker claims it.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: the run of the chat that takes the next message: the latest that resumes it

state.title: State
state.description: that run's state

status.title: Status
status.description: working: the agent works on its turn; waiting: it waits for your reply (waiting or parked); ended: the run ended

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: the login of the run's owner, the one member who replies

plan_id.title: Plan Id
plan_id.description: the plan the run wrote or revises; null before its first put

plan_revision.title: Plan Revision
plan_revision.description: that plan's revision the run last wrote, or was dispatched on

more.title: More
more.description: older messages were left out: the chat shows its 1000 latest

queued.title: Queued
queued.description: false when a build of the project was waiting already, which counts as queued

created.title: Created
created.description: false when the run was in the corpus already

held.title: Held
held.description: false for a run the worker no longer holds; stop it

state.title: State
state.description: null for a run that is not this worker's

takeover.title: Takeover
takeover.description: the owner asked to drive the agent in a terminal: report interactive

handback.title: Handback
handback.description: the owner asked to let the agent go on headless: report running

terminal_open.title: Terminal Open
terminal_open.description: a browser waits for the run's terminal: connect WS /v1/worker/runs/{id}/terminal once the run is interactive

park.title: Park
park.description: the run is parked (it waited too long for an answer), or done because a new run resumes it: stop the agent at the end of its turn, keep the session and the worktrees, free the slot

finish.title: Finish
finish.description: the owner ended the chat of this author run: once the agent's turn is over, end the run done

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: messages from the owner waiting for the agent: POST .../runs/{id}/inbox

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.description: decisions of the run still open, waiting for the owner's answer

lost.title: Lost
lost.description: runs whose worker stopped extending the lease

cancelled.title: Cancelled
cancelled.description: runs that ended cancelled, queued or not

p50_seconds.title: P50 Seconds
p50_seconds.description: the median time the runs that ended ran, from started (else leased) to finished, as the runs pages count it; null when none of them started

p90_seconds.title: P90 Seconds
p90_seconds.description: the 90th percentile of that time; null when none of them started

input_tokens.title: Input Tokens
input_tokens.description: input tokens not read from the cache, added up from the runs' usage as the run page's usage card reads it

cache_read_tokens.title: Cache Read Tokens
cache_read_tokens.description: input tokens read from the cache

runs_with_usage.title: Runs With Usage
runs_with_usage.description: the runs whose usage the hub could read: a run without usage, or with usage of no shape the card knows (Claude Code, Codex, opencode), adds no token

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: <plugin>/<name>, as the environment axis of a profile names it

version.title: Version
version.description: the plugin's installed version

image.title: Image
image.description: [registry/]repository[:tag]@sha256:<digest>, pulled and run by that digest

mounts.title: Mounts
mounts.description: besides the worktree and the run's home

RunEnvironment.title: RunEnvironment
RunEnvironment.description:
An environment a plugin enabled on a project declares (``evo_agents.plugins.run_environments``): a container
image pinned by its digest, at the plugin's version the hub has installed.

seq.title: Seq
seq.description: the hub's number of the event in the run: events?after= and Last-Event-ID take it

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: the hub cut the body to 64 KiB of JSON

last_seq.title: Last Seq
last_seq.description: the seq of the run's latest event

more.title: More
more.description: more events follow the last one here: ask again after it

lost.title: Lost
lost.description: runs whose worker stopped extending the lease

cancelled.title: Cancelled
cancelled.description: runs that ended cancelled, queued or not

p50_seconds.title: P50 Seconds
p50_seconds.description: the median time the runs that ended ran, from started (else leased) to finished, as the runs pages count it; null when none of them started

p90_seconds.title: P90 Seconds
p90_seconds.description: the 90th percentile of that time; null when none of them started

input_tokens.title: Input Tokens
input_tokens.description: input tokens not read from the cache, added up from the runs' usage as the run page's usage card reads it

cache_read_tokens.title: Cache Read Tokens
cache_read_tokens.description: input tokens read from the cache

runs_with_usage.title: Runs With Usage
runs_with_usage.description: the runs whose usage the hub could read: a run without usage, or with usage of no shape the card knows (Claude Code, Codex, opencode), adds no token

RunFigures.title: RunFigures
RunFigures.description: The runs that ended in a span of UTC days, of the plans the caller may read.

name.title: Name
name.description: the secret's name, github-app:<account>, @<handle>:<name> for an account of an agent, gateway:<model> for a run's key of the model gateway, or the provider account's name that key reaches

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: secret: the owner's; github-app: a token the hub's App made; gateway: the model gateway's; run-access: the run's own token of the hub, as its owner (evo_agents.hub.server.run_access)

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: env: a variable of the agent; git: what git's helper answered; gateway: a run's key of the model gateway, or a provider account it reaches; hub: the run's token of the hub

target.title: Target
target.description: kind env and hub: the variable it set; kind git: the origins of the run's repos it answered for, space-separated, in the form of normalize_origin; kind gateway: the model

worker.title: Worker
worker.description: the worker it was leased to

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: when it stops working: a GitHub token's hour, a secret's end

revoked_at.title: Revoked At
revoked_at.description: when the run gave it back or the hub took it; null while out

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: the handle of the agent profile it was handed out under; null for a lease before schema 0030

RunLease.title: RunLease
RunLease.description: A lease a run got, as its owner sees it: everything but the value.

counts.description: runs in each state that match the other filters: what the state filter would leave

url.title: Url
url.description: presigned GET of the log, as the corpus that ran it wrote it (jsonl.gz)

target.title: Target
target.description: the absolute path in the container

name.title: Name
name.description: a volume's name within the plugin; the worker names it evo-<plugin>-<name>

size_mb.title: Size Mb
size_mb.description: a tmpfs's size; null: the engine's default

RunMount.title: RunMount
RunMount.description: A mount of a plugin's environment (``evo_agents.plugins.run_environments.Mount``).

github_id.title: Github Id
github_id.description: the person's GitHub user id; null for a user the hub never saw on GitHub

RunOrigin.title: RunOrigin
RunOrigin.description:
The person at the origin of a claimed run, who dispatched it (for a chat run, the person whose message began
the chain of agents): the worker names them as the co-author of the commits of a run its agent authors.

source.title: Source
source.description: sent: a file the agent sent; tool: an image taken out of a tool's result; outputs: a file of the run's .evo-run/outputs/

name.title: Name
name.description: the file's name, or its path below .evo-run/outputs/

media_type.title: Media Type
media_type.description: type/subtype, as the machine that sent it named it

viewer.title: Viewer
viewer.description: what the web opens it with; none offers a download only

tool_call_id.title: Tool Call Id
tool_call_id.description: the tool call of the run's trace it came from, when one

url.title: Url
url.description: where this hub answers its bytes to the reader of what listed it; ?download=true for a download

tool_images.title: Tool Images
tool_images.description: the project takes images out of tools' results (outputs of source tool)

max_file_bytes.title: Max File Bytes
max_file_bytes.description: the most bytes one output has

max_outputs.title: Max Outputs
max_outputs.description: the most outputs a run holds

max_run_bytes.title: Max Run Bytes
max_run_bytes.description: the most bytes of outputs a run holds, a SHA-256 counted once

outputs.title: Outputs
outputs.description: oldest first, those the filters keep

tool_images.title: Tool Images
tool_images.description: the project takes images out of tools' results

version.title: Version
version.description: the version of the plugin the profile pins

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: what the downloaded bundle must hash to

url.title: Url
url.description: presigned GET of the plugin's bundle; a bearer credential until it expires

RunPack.title: RunPack
RunPack.description:
An agent pack the run's profile attaches (``evo_agents.plugins.agent_packs``), as the hub holds the version of
its plugin the profile pins: the worker downloads the plugin's bundle, checks it, and builds the pack from its
``packs/<name>/`` into the run's directory for the agent's runtime.

version.title: Version
version.description: the version installed when a worker claimed the run

config_digest.title: Config Digest
config_digest.description: the digest of the run's effective config then

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: to add to the agent's system prompt; empty for none

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: the eight axes, each {mode: all} or {mode: allowlist, allow: [...]}; an axis a version from before the axis does not name allows all

RunProfile.title: RunProfile
RunProfile.description:
The agent profile of a claimed run, at the version the run went under, for its worker to apply what the hub
cannot (``evo_agents.hub.profiles``): tool, skill and model in the agent session, and the instructions.

log_upload_id.title: Log Upload Id
log_upload_id.description: the upload of the log, asked for with kind kg-log

log_sha256.title: Log Sha256
log_sha256.description: instead of an upload: a log the project holds already

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: null when the plan names none: the branch checked out

RunRepo.title: RunRepo
RunRepo.description: A repo of a plan run, with the branch the plan names for it.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: as a project registered it; null when none did

path.title: Path
path.description: as that project registered it: relative to its workspace, ~/..., or absolute

project.title: Project
project.description: the project that registered it: the run's, or another of its owner's

RunRepoSource.title: RunRepoSource
RunRepoSource.description: A repo of the run and where it comes from (``repo_origins``), so a worker without a checkout of it clones it.

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: what the downloaded bytes must hash to

url.title: Url
url.description: presigned GET of the bundle; a bearer credential until it expires

RunSkill.title: RunSkill
RunSkill.description:
A skill the worker writes for the run's agent, as the hub holds it when the run is claimed: an author run's
create-exec-plan, global, at its latest version.

plan_revision.title: Plan Revision
plan_revision.description: the plan revision the run was dispatched from; null for a review run

resume_of_run_id.title: Resume Of Run Id
resume_of_run_id.description: the parked plan run this one goes on from: reuse its worktrees and resume its session

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: the agent session to resume; null for a new one

lost_attempt.description: a plan run's attempt before this one, which the hub lost on this same worker (it stopped extending the lease), on the same runtime: the worker goes on in its agent's session and worktrees when it still has both, else starts as for any other attempt; null for any other run

runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.description: a runtime of the core, or <plugin>/<name>, run with plugin_runtime's declaration

model.title: Model
model.description: the model the dispatch asked for; null: the runtime's own choice

repos.title: Repos
repos.description: a plan run's or a review run's repos, each with a checkout on this worker

plan.description: a plan run's plan at the hub's current revision, for .evo-run/plan.yaml; null for a run of one step

budget.description: the caps of a run the night shift queued; null otherwise

curator.description: a run of the Curator: its role and what its worker checks; null for any other run

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: the skills the worker writes under .claude/skills of the run's directory for its agent: an author run's create-exec-plan; empty for any other run

verify.title: Verify
verify.description: the verify of the step of a run of one step, as the plan it was dispatched from has it: the worker's preflight checks that each program it calls is on PATH before the agent starts; null for any other kind, whose worker reads the verify elsewhere (a plan run's plan, a judge run's inputs)

session_per_step.title: Session Per Step
session_per_step.description: a plan run to run with a new agent session for each step not done yet, each with its prompt and the handoff of the plan; false: one session does every step, with the prompt above

browser.title: Browser
browser.description: true: start a Chromium for the run's agent before its first turn and hand its DevTools endpoint to the agent (EVO_BROWSER_CDP); absent for a run without one

browser_identities.title: Browser Identities
browser_identities.description: the ids of the browser identities to open the run's Chromium with (POST /v1/worker/runs/{id}/browser-profile hands each one's profile), in order; absent for a run without them

profile.description: the agent profile the run went under; null for a run from before schema 0030

own_home.title: Own Home
own_home.description: true for a run under a profile that is not its project's default: the agent of a claude-code run gets a Claude Code config dir of its own in the run's directory instead of the owner's

origin.description: the person who dispatched the run, whom the worker names as co-author of the commits of a chat run and of a run under a profile that is not its project's default; null from a hub that does not send it

plugin_runtime.description: for a run of a plugin's runtime, its declaration at the plugin's version installed now, which the worker runs through its adapter of ACP; null for a runtime of the core

environment.description: the environment of a plugin the claim picked from the run's profile, at the plugin's version installed now, which the worker's container provider runs the agent in; null: the worker's host

packs.title: Packs
packs.description: the agent packs the run's profile attaches, in its order, each at the version it pins, which the worker builds into the run's directory for its runtime; empty for a profile that attaches none

release.description: a release run's cycle, mode and start commit; null for any other run

autonomy.description: the autonomy card its prompt opens with; null for a run without a snapshot of autonomy

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: a chat run's: the files of the chat message that opened it (chat_message_id), whose bytes GET /v1/worker/runs/{id}/attachments/{aid}/content serves; empty for any other run

chat_message_id.title: Chat Message Id
chat_message_id.description: a chat run's: the chat message that opened it, whose files the worker saves under .evo-run/inbox/chat-<id>/; null for any other run

missing.title: Missing
missing.description: of those, the ones the project does not hold yet: upload them, then commit

days.title: Days
days.description: the days counted, today in UTC the last

first_day.title: First Day
first_day.description: the oldest day counted, in UTC

by_day.title: By Day
by_day.description: every day counted, the oldest first: a day without a run has zeros and null percentiles

total.description: the whole span: its counts and tokens are by_day's added up, its percentiles over every run

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: the most called first; empty for a run that has not ended

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: what the Skill tool loaded, the most called first; empty before schema 0087

model.title: Model
model.description: as a run asks for it: <prefix>/<model>

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: the catalog's alias of its provider, or evo-<id> for an endpoint of a member

runtimes.title: Runtimes
runtimes.description: the runtimes that run it through the model gateway; any picks one

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: the names of the provider accounts that serve it, by name

ingested.title: Ingested
ingested.description: run ids in the project's corpus

pending.title: Pending
pending.description: run ids whose log the hub has, waiting for their blobs and the commit

available.title: Available
available.description: whether runs may use it; false with a reason when it is installed but not

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: why it is unavailable

models.title: Models
models.description: the models the runtime lists on the machine, for a dispatch to suggest; null when it lists none

RuntimeReport.title: RuntimeReport
RuntimeReport.description: One runtime as the daemon found it on the machine.

skill.title: Skill
skill.description: the skill a call of the Skill tool loaded

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: calls an update of which said failed

gen_ai.tool.name.title: Gen Ai.Tool.Name
gen_ai.tool.name.description: the tool, as the module of tool_stats names it

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: calls an update of which said failed

duration_ms.title: Duration Ms
duration_ms.description: from each call to its result, added up; calls that never ended count none

result.title: Result
result.description: faulty counts as a pass of the Judge found wrong

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: the member its runs are dispatched as

worker.title: Worker
worker.description: the worker its runs go to; null for a pool

pool.title: Pool
pool.description: the pool whose ready nodes take its runs; null for a worker

paused_by.title: Paused By
paused_by.description: the member who paused it; null when the hub did, or while it runs

pause_reason.title: Pause Reason
pause_reason.description: why the hub paused it, its circuit breaker; null when a member did, or while it runs

state.title: State
state.description: newest: the graph the kg tools read; live: a source blob a run in use refers to; old: neither

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.description: the secrets it holds, by kind; never a value

builds.title: Builds
builds.description: for a graph, the builds pointing at it

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: why it stays: in use, holds no secret now, not in the bucket, or not the project's

missing.title: Missing
missing.description: objects the bucket lacks or holds with other bytes, not read

next.title: Next
next.description: pass as after for the next page; null after the last

builds.title: Builds
builds.description: builds whose graph was deleted: they keep their row, content hash and counts

deleted.title: Deleted
deleted.description: objects deleted from the bucket by this request

pending.title: Pending
pending.description: objects that still wait to be deleted; the next prune or purge tries again

after.title: After
after.description: next of the page before; left out for the first page

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: objects this page reads at most

reports_to.title: Reports To
reports_to.description: the person the seat reports to; an intern's needs one

sponsor.title: Sponsor
sponsor.description: the person answering for an agent's seat; it needs one

primary.title: Primary
primary.description: whether the seat decides the person's ceiling; when left out it does if their primary seat now is at the root or they hold none

SeatAdd.title: SeatAdd
SeatAdd.description: A seat for a person (login) or for an agent profile (agent and project).

classes.title: Classes
classes.description: K1 to K12, the effective mode of the seat and its units

primary.title: Primary
primary.description: make it the person's primary seat

SeatEdit.title: SeatEdit
SeatEdit.description: The fields to change; a field left out keeps its value, reports_to or ends_on null clears it.

env_var.title: Env Var
env_var.description: kind env: the variable it sets

url_prefix.title: Url Prefix
url_prefix.description: kinds git and forge: the https prefix of the origins it answers for

username.title: Username
username.description: kind git: the user git sends with it

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: kind env: the environment it is labelled for (test)

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: the projects whose runs get it

workers.title: Workers

version_locked.description: its owner locked its version: the daemon stays on the evo-agents it runs and does not update itself; a hub before 0048 sends none, and a daemon that got none does not update itself either

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: the projects the worker serves, by name, as its owner set them; a hub before evo-ak 0.31.2 sends none, and a daemon that got none keeps those of its config

worker.title: Worker
worker.description: the worker's name, unique among its owner's live workers

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: the login of the member who registered it

shared.title: Shared
shared.description: whether other members' runs may go to it

units.title: Units
units.description: the slugs of the units it is narrowed to, sorted; none: shared with every writer of a project it serves

doctor_at.title: Doctor At
doctor_at.description: when its daemon sent the newest doctor report; null: none

doctor_high.title: Doctor High
doctor_high.description: findings of severity high in that report; null: no report

doctor_medium.title: Doctor Medium
doctor_medium.description: findings of severity medium in that report; null: no report

WorkerShares.title: WorkerShares
WorkerShares.description: Whom a worker is shared with: its owner's writers, narrowed to ``units`` when it names any.

slots.title: Slots
slots.description: runs the worker holds at once

taints.title: Taints
taints.description: its own taints, a word or key=value, the whole list ([] for none): it takes only the runs that tolerate each, or those pinned to it

name.title: Name
name.description: unique among the owner's workers not revoked

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: the plugins whose runtimes and environments it takes; [] for none

version_locked.title: Version Locked
version_locked.description: true: its daemon stays on the evo-agents it runs; false: it updates itself to the tag nightly again, once idle

shared.title: Shared
shared.description: true: it also takes the runs of every member who holds writer on a project it serves; false: its owner's runs alone, every worker's default

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: every project it takes runs of, the whole list: the writer role on each one added; one dropped must have no active run on the worker and no night shift on duty there

WorkerUpdate.title: WorkerUpdate
WorkerUpdate.description: What PATCH /v1/workers/{id} changes: each field it gives, at least one; a field left out or null stays.

requested_at.title: Requested At
requested_at.description: when its owner or a hub admin asked for it

ended_at.title: Ended At
ended_at.description: when it ended; null while the daemon carries it out

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: how it ended: current, the daemon runs the commit of nightly the hub read; cancelled; failed, the install failed (self_update.error says how); impossible, the daemon cannot update itself; null while open

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: why it failed or was impossible, as the daemon or the hub said

WorkerUpdateNow.title: WorkerUpdateNow
WorkerUpdateNow.description: The last Update now of a worker: open while ended_at is null (POST /v1/workers/{id}/update-now).

current.description: the version the hub holds, when the caller may see it

read_at.title: Read At
read_at.description: an agent's memory: when the agent of a run last opened it

archived_at.title: Archived At
archived_at.description: an agent's memory: when the hub archived it, nobody having opened it for 30 days; out of the index and the searches of runs until a writer restores it

stale_at.title: Stale At
stale_at.description: an agent's memory: since when a path it cites (code:REPO:PATH) is gone from the graph

promoted_at.title: Promoted At
promoted_at.description: an agent's memory: when an accepted proposal of the Curator promoted it into a shared memory; out of the index and the searches of runs from then on, until a new revision

promoted_into.title: Promoted Into
promoted_into.description: the shared memory it was promoted into, while it exists

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: the login of the person who created it

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: the handle of the agent profile whose memory it is; else null

body.title: Body
body.description: the whole file; empty for a tombstone

changed.title: Changed
changed.description: false when the hub already held exactly this

current.title: Current
current.description: the plan as the hub holds it, when the caller may see it

digest.title: Digest
digest.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the body, as evo_agents.harness.plan_digest

changed.title: Changed
changed.description: false when the hub already held exactly this; no revision was added

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: what plan_semantics found; the plan was stored anyway

base_sha.title: Base Sha
base_sha.description: the first parent of the oldest of its commits, once a replay read it

unusable.title: Unusable
unusable.description: why no replay can run it

verify.title: Verify
verify.description: the step's verify, one shell line: the worker runs it on each arm's work

commits.title: Commits
commits.description: the commits the step made, as its evidence or a run of it named them

base_sha.title: Base Sha
base_sha.description: the first parent of the oldest of its commits; null: the worker finds it

evo_agents__hub__server__runs__models__R.description:
The task a replay run does again (``evo_agents.hub.replay``): a step of a plan done before, in its repo, from its
base commit (null until a replay of it read it from its commits).
